notes: No genuine Clearance/Outlet-type PLP found on goodearth.in, and no ambiguous Sale-worded page found either. Access: direct HTTP fetch (no WAF, robots.txt allows general crawling, no Claude-specific disallow); confirmed with Playwright rendering. Checked: (1) sitemap.xml -> sitemap-header.xml and sitemap-footer.xml -> no Clearance/Outlet/Sale/Final-Sale/Last-Chance/End-of-Line URL anywhere. (2) Rendered /sitemap page (full site index, 138 links) -> same, no such entry, and no generic 'Sale' page either. (3) Rendered homepage (scrolled fully) -> only two promo banners present ('Free shipping...Shop Now' linking to Dinnerware, and 'Explore the new apparel collection - Saanjh' linking to the Saanjh apparel line) - neither is a clearance/sale merchandising page. (4) Guessed URL shapes /sale and /clearance rendered via Playwright: both fall through to the SPA's default homepage content (identical to the deliberately nonexistent control URL /nonexistent-random-xyz123), proving these are not real routes. (5) Site's own product-search API was tested with 'sale' and 'clearance' query terms - the search param is silently ignored and always returns the full catalog count (884), confirmed against a nonsense control query returning the identical count; not relied on as absence proof per prior false-absence pattern. (6) Pulled the complete categoryShop taxonomy facet list from the search API (18 real nodes, listed in the Bestsellers file's notes) - none represents Clearance/Outlet/Sale merchandising. Concluded: no Clearance PLP exists on this site; nothing ambiguous (no ordinary 'Sale' page) was found either, so no flagged row is emitted.
